definition: relating to art or the people who make it
description: A bright art studio with white brick walls and paint-splashed windows. A young woman in paint-covered white trousers and a rust-coloured top throws a huge wave of blue paint from a tin onto a big canvas full of orange and pink swirls, and the paint runs down onto the floor. She laughs and throws her head back. A young man in a paint-spotted T-shirt paints the top of the canvas from a stepladder, and other young people stand at easels in the back with a plaster bust and tables of paint.

taps.phrase: to fling paint at the canvas
